summary: The agent failed the verifier despite producing outputs because it wrote custom simulation code instead of adapting the existing queue-capacity-planning skill. The radiology backlog task follows the same step-down staffing pattern but with different domain parameters (capacity 156/130/104, overtime 12/6/0, threshold 104), different Excel headers, and different summary constraints (27 words, 2 sentences, mentions 'Project PulseLift' and 'Milestone'). This new skill captures the radiology-specific variant so future agents can adapt the existing simulator or use the correct parameters directly.
